what_this_is: Relevance of every claim the URL-first arm (uncitable records excluded at retrieval) displayed on the frozen 134-question probe set, judged against the QUESTION it was shown for. Model-judged, two blind passes plus adjudication, with a question-derangement control arm. NOT human validation; the 40-item author-graded sheet is, and its agreement is reported under human_check when available.

provenance.arm: the URL-first arm (uncitable records excluded at retrieval)

judge.decoding: not set; harness defaults, so the passes are not bitwise reproducible
judge.model_checkpoint: NOT RECOVERABLE: no script pins a model, so each judge subagent inherited the session's model. Family is Anthropic Claude via Claude Code. See the configuration file; the paper states this as a limitation rather than naming a version it cannot prove.

support_x_relevance.note: Rows are the entailment label of the same displayed claim (claim vs cited passage); columns are relevance (claim vs question). The paper's point sits in supported x not_relevant: well-cited, well-supported, and beside the question.

human_check.graded_by: the author, with model labels hidden on the sheet

human_relevant_rate.no_interval_quoted: See interval_method. A descriptive calibration estimate, not population inference.
